Here is an actual online comment that I saw: 
"My husband keeps putting the trash bag too tight, so the garbage doesn 'twalk ' in and we end  up getting bugs in my home." How to help him put it the correct tight?
When you mention about putting a "garabuge bag in the wrong tight ness level " I understand that he wants you want you want to ensure the waste is secured inside but without making a huge gap between bag edge & garbage puch. You have few ways to achieve this.
The main thing to understand first, garbage needs space to breath & to let some gasy escape otherwise bag can blow up, get damaged by excessive gas inside. But you need it not so open so insects can enter, that means it's neither too closed nor open but somewhere middle where the air inside can pass easily but outside world is cutt of by the edge, that will help. You should consider putting the garbage in two bags or putting garbage inside the bin and the bag inside a pail to make more room, this helps to ensure there are some holes that let gases pass and also makes less attractive entry way  to insect,
